definitions.gloss: part; site; region (of the body or an object)
definitions.explanation: A specific location or area, especially of the human body. Commonly used in medical, anatomical, and culinary (meat cuts) contexts.

examples.japanese: {痛|いた}みのある{部位|ぶい}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me where it hurts.
examples.notes: Literally: Please tell me the part where there is pain.

examples.japanese: この{部位|ぶい}の{肉|にく}は{脂|あぶら}が{少|すく}なくてヘルシーだ。
examples.english: The meat from this cut is low in fat and healthy.

examples.japanese: {手術|しゅじゅつ}する{部位|ぶい}にマーカーで{印|しるし}をつけてから{手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: The surgical site is marked before entering the operating room.

notes:
USAGE:
{部位|ぶい} is more specific and technical than {部分|ぶぶん} (part, portion). While {部分|ぶぶん} can refer to any part of anything, {部位|ぶい} is most naturally used for body parts, anatomical regions, and cuts of meat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {患部|かんぶ}の{部位|ぶい} (affected area)
- {肉|にく}の{部位|ぶい} (cut of meat)
- {部位|ぶい}{別|べつ} (by body part/region)

DOMAIN:
Frequently used in medical contexts ({手術|しゅじゅつ}{部位|ぶい} — surgical site) and in butchery/cooking when discussing different cuts of meat.
